CUL Funding Request

Fill out Section I and your name and grade, then export the official CUL Funding Request PDF. Everything else is optional.

How a CUL request works

  1. Request. Fill out this form, export the PDF, and email it to jeannie.schroeder@us.af.mil at least 10 business days out (15 for box meals).
  2. Mitchell Hall approves and signs the form. Don't buy or order anything before this.
  3. Route an eSSS to the group POC for Group CC approval, with the signed form attached. See the example on the Documents tab.
  4. Send the approved eSSS to Mitchell Hall before the event, plus the merchant invoice if Mitchell Hall is paying directly.
  5. After the event, sign Section III and send itemized receipts within 1 business day.

How a gift fund purchase works

  1. Do market research and fill out the Market Research Report. Check the sources in order: agency stock (DRMO), UNICOR, AbilityOne/Envision, DLA wholesale, then GSA/AF Advantage mandatory and optional schedules. Review the DAF Launchpad first: if a mandatory source has the item, you must use it.
  2. Fill out the Request for Funds with the vendor, each item, quantity and price, shipping, and the purpose.
  3. Route for signatures, in order: requestor, cardholder, approving official, then Group Commander.
  4. Log it in the tracker as Requested, then update it to Approved, Swiped (card charged) and Posted as it moves.

If no source has the item, the purchase goes through contracting instead.

      CUL Funds Food Support Procedures (Squadrons)
      Rules, rates and the three payment options for squadron events
      Read procedures

      General rules

      • CUL funds come from the Cadet Subsistence Fund and buy food and non-alcoholic drinks only.
      • Available during the academic year through Dean's Weekend. No events after 10 May 2027; funds restart when school starts in August.
      • For cadet-related events (training, mentorship, social decorum, etiquette training). Not for parties.
      • Not available during Mandatory Lunch or Cadet Wing-wide events (box meals may be provided).
      • 10 business days' notice required; 15 days for box meals.
      • Up to $2,000 per academic year, usable anywhere including the Club, Golf Course and Bowling Center.
      • Tailgates and wing-wide directed training do not come out of the squadron's allocation.
      • Mitchell Hall cannot pay for non-cadets, room charges, surcharges, taxes, tips, paper products or alcohol. Only food and non-alcoholic drinks for cadets.
      • No food for squadron snack bars or fundraisers.
      • Squadron commanders are responsible for proper use. Cadets need approval from the SQ/CC or AMT.
      • The whole squadron attends one event; it cannot be split into multiple events.
      • Funding depends on the Cadet Subsistence Fund's financial posture and may change.
      • Supt pricing: $5.00 breakfast, $7.00 lunch, $9.00 dinner.
      • After Mitchell Hall approves your CUL Request, route an eSSS to the designated group POC for Group CC final approval, with the Mitchell Hall–signed CUL form attached. Send the approved eSSS to Mitchell Hall before the event.

      Option 1 · Falcon Club, Golf Course or Bowling Center

      • Reimbursed up to $5 breakfast · $7 lunch · $9 dinner per cadet (not during Mandatory Lunch or wing-wide events).
      • Make arrangements with the venue.
      • POC completes the CUL Request Form; the Squadron Commander or AMT signs as requestor. Email it to jeannie.schroeder@us.af.mil.
      • Mitchell Hall enters an authorization number; the venue asks for it before confirming.
      • After Mitchell Hall approves your CUL Request, route an eSSS to the designated group POC for Group CC final approval, with the Mitchell Hall–signed CUL form attached. Send the approved eSSS to Mitchell Hall before the event.
      • Mitchell Hall pays the venue its portion after the event; the squadron pays all other charges and non-cadets.
      • After the event, sign Section III and send the form back.

      Option 2 · Store or grocery purchase, or a vendor Mitchell Hall can't pay

      • Reimbursed up to $5 breakfast · $7 lunch · $9 dinner per cadet (not during Mandatory Lunch or wing-wide events).
      • 10 business days' notice required.
      • Complete the CUL Request Form and get Mitchell Hall approval before buying.
      • After Mitchell Hall approves your CUL Request, route an eSSS to the designated group POC for Group CC final approval, with the Mitchell Hall–signed CUL form attached. Send the approved eSSS to Mitchell Hall before the event.
      • Pay out of pocket; the squadron account is reimbursed after the event.
      • A squadron bank account must be on file before reimbursement. If not, complete an EFT Form and send it right away (confirmation comes from 10FSS.FSR.NAFDisbursement@us.af.mil). If one is on file, send the last four digits of the account number.
      • You may have to pay tax, which isn't reimbursed. A Commissary surcharge can be paid.
      • Turn in itemized receipts after the event and sign Section III.
      • Mitchell Hall determines the reimbursement amount; send reimbursement requests to Jeannie Schroeder, who forwards them to NAF Disbursement.

      Option 3 · Mitchell Hall pays the vendor directly

      • For vendors that accept payment by phone or online. You won't pay out of pocket unless the vendor is prohibited or won't take phone payment. For online orders, your POC places the order.
      • Breakfast, dinner or weekend events only.
      • 10 business days' notice required.
      • Complete the CUL Request Form and get Mitchell Hall approval before contacting the merchant.
      • Reimbursed up to $5 breakfast · $7 lunch · $9 dinner per cadet (not during Mandatory Lunch or wing-wide events).
      • After Mitchell Hall approves your CUL Request, route an eSSS to the designated group POC for Group CC final approval, with the Mitchell Hall–signed CUL form attached. Send the approved eSSS to Mitchell Hall before the event.
      • Send the merchant's invoice before the event (squadron events: at least 3 business days prior). It must show invoice number, date, merchant name/address, POC name and phone, and an itemized list. Cadets only; non-cadets and other charges need a separate invoice.
      • Mitchell Hall does not place orders or contact the vendor to order.
      • Mitchell Hall pays by government purchase card, online (order placed by your POC and showing tax exemption) or by phone, never in person. Tell the merchant you are tax exempt; Mitchell Hall can send the tax-exempt number.
      • Mitchell Hall pays after receiving the eSSS and invoice.
      • After the event, sign Section III and send the form back.

      Failure to pick up purchased food may forfeit remaining semester events and/or CUL funds and require reimbursing Mitchell Hall. Spending CUL funds without prior Mitchell Hall approval may leave the squadron paying the merchant.

      CUL Fund Procedures (Home Football Games)
      Requesting CUL funds for tailgates at home games
      Read procedures

      Option 1 · Pay out of pocket, get reimbursed

      For store purchases, or vendors Mitchell Hall can't pay by purchase card.

      • 10 business days' notice required.
      • Squadron POC completes the CUL Request Form for Mitchell Hall approval.
      • A squadron bank account must be on file before reimbursement. If not, complete an EFT Form and send it right away (confirmation comes from 10FSS.FSR.NAFDisbursement@us.af.mil). If one is on file, send the last four digits of the account number.
      • Pay out of pocket; reimbursed after the event up to $5 breakfast, $7 lunch or $9 dinner per cadet.
      • You may have to pay tax, which isn't reimbursed. Mitchell Hall cannot pay for non-cadets, room charges, surcharges, taxes, tips, paper products or alcohol. Only food and non-alcoholic drinks for cadets.
      • Turn in a paid, itemized receipt after the event and sign Section III.
      • Mitchell Hall determines the amount; reimbursement goes through Jeannie Schroeder to NAF Disbursement.

      Option 2 · Mitchell Hall pays the vendor directly

      • For vendors that accept payment by phone or online. For online orders, your POC places the order.
      • 10 business days' notice required.
      • Complete the CUL Request Form and get Mitchell Hall approval before contacting the merchant.
      • Up to $5 breakfast, $7 lunch, $9 dinner per cadet.
      • Contact the merchant's catering department and make all arrangements.
      • Send the merchant's invoice before the event. It must show invoice number, date, merchant name/address, POC name and phone, and an itemized list. Cadets only; non-cadets and other charges need a separate invoice.
      • Mitchell Hall pays by government purchase card, online (order placed by your POC and showing tax exemption) or by phone, never in person. Tell the merchant you are tax exempt; Mitchell Hall can send the tax-exempt number.
      • Mitchell Hall cannot pay for non-cadets, room charges, surcharges, taxes, tips, paper products or alcohol. Only food and non-alcoholic drinks for cadets.
      • Mitchell Hall pays after receiving your invoice.

      Option 3 · Commissary tailgates Currently not available

      • No out-of-pocket cost.
      • At least 2½ weeks' notice (the Commissary needs 14 days).
      • Get Mitchell Hall approval before contacting the Commissary.
      • Follow the Commissary Tailgate Kit Order Process and complete the Commissary Tailgate Menu.
      • Commissary surcharges can be paid.

      Failure to pick up purchased food may forfeit remaining semester events and/or CUL funds and require reimbursing Mitchell Hall. Spending CUL funds without prior Mitchell Hall approval may leave the squadron paying the merchant.

      Example eSSS: CW/CV approval for CUL funds
      Staff Summary Sheet routed CW/DS → CW/CCC → CW/CV after Mitchell Hall approves the request
      What goes in it
      • Subject: Requests for Cadet Unit Leadership (CUL) Funds
      • Routing: CW/DS (coord), CW/CCC (coord), CW/CV (approve/disapprove)
      • 1. Purpose: request Vice Commandant approval to execute CUL funds on the event date
      • 2. Background: what the event is, where and when
      • 3. Discussion: note that 10FSS approved the CUL request, other funding sources, caterer, and why the event matters for the squadron
      • 4. Considerations: impact if not funded
      • 5. Recommendation: approve CUL funds execution
      • Attachment: the CUL Request Form approved by Mitchell Hall
